title: Rowwise modular transformation
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, define its rowwise modular transformation by applying the wordwise mapping operation to $w$ with the entrywise modular transformation.
caveat: The definition of the wordwise mapping operation is not included, so its precise effect on the list cannot be stated.
